reports.title: Exelixis Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Corporate Update

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Exelixis is providing the following updated financial guidance for fiscal year 2026. Net product and total revenues guidance do not currently reflect any revenues resulting from a potential U.S. regulatory approval and commercial launch of zanzalintinib for the treatment of patients with previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer (CRC). The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is currently reviewing Exelixis' New Drug Application (NDA) for this proposed indication, when used in combination with atezolizumab (Tecentriq®).

Current Guidance (provided on October 29, 2026) | Previous Guidance (provided on August 5, 2026)
Total revenues | $2.500 billion - $2.550 billion | $2.500 billion - $2.550 billion
Net product revenues | $2.300 billion - $2.350 billion(1) | $2.300 billion - $2.350 billion(1)
Cost of goods sold, % of net product revenues | ~4% | 3.5% - 4.5%
Research and development expenses | $825 million - $875 million(2) | $825 million - $875 million(2)
Selling, general and administrative expenses | $575 million - $625 million(3) | $575 million - $625 million(3)
Effective tax rate | 16% - 18% | 21% - 23%
